generate_embedding: generate a random numpy embedding array with configurable length, dimension, and dtype
generate_saved_embedding: generate a random embedding and save it to a file in numpy or legacy format
generate_n_saved_embeddings: generate multiple sharded embedding files and return a stacked array with file paths
test_generate_embedding: test the generate_embedding function by creating random embeddings with custom dimensions and dtype
test_generate_saved_embedding: test the generate_saved_embedding function by saving embeddings to disk in legacy or numpy mode
